_comment: Scan ident (+ optional HW variant) -> definition file. The device ADDRESS is not part of this; it is taken from the scan at runtime and stamped onto the messages, so identical devices behind different bus couplers share one file. A bus coupler (e.g. V32) is only the scan key -- the file defines the device BEHIND it, distinguished by its HW variant (eloBlock vs a heat pump both scan as V32). All files are our own Apache-2.0 work: eloblock/netx3 are authored, the device types (ctlv3/pmw/vr_71/hmu/v32.hp) are re-engineered from an observed bus capture (see aioebus configs/vaillant/PROVENANCE.md). 'Broadcast' is a synthetic circuit (address 0xfe) the coordinator injects for bus broadcasts (outside temperature, date/time). 'names' maps a definition file to the friendly device name shown in Home Assistant; without an entry the scan ident is used.
